spawn: The canonical Belmont Rocks spawn: the chibi mayor on green lawn atop stepped tan revetment terraces, beach towels/umbrellas/coolers scattered on the steps, dusk-peach sky and blue lake with floaties, minimap top-right. Must match baseline.png composition.
zone-aids-garden-chicago: AIDS Garden Chicago: colorful flower beds around a circular plaza loop, with the 30-ft green Keith Haring figure sculpture dominating the scene. Lawn setting west of the rocks.
zone-the-belmont-rocks: The Belmont Rocks hangout: stepped revetment terraces stepping down to the lake, dotted with colorful towels, tilted umbrellas and coolers; open blue water east.
zone-diversey-point: Diversey Point, the map's south corner: the 7-step terraced revetment curving from east-facing to south-facing, big south lawn behind, blue Chevron sculpture and/or corner pier nearby; skyline may read to the south.
zone-belmont-harbor: Belmont Harbor basin: calm water with rows of moored sailboats (mooring cans), west-shore finger docks with boats, the treed spit peninsula east across the water.
zone-harbor-pier: The harbor pier deck: wooden planks over water at the basin edge, rails/lamp, boats and harbor water around it.
zone-yacht-club: The yacht club on the west shore lawn: clubhouse building with a burgee pole facing the water, docks nearby.
zone-dog-beach: The dog beach cove: a small rounded sand cove with fence and gates, dogs/fetch play on the sand, harbor water beyond; the trail passes north of the cove, never crossing the sand.
zone-kwanusila: The Kwanusila totem pole on the inner lawn: a tall carved pole with painted figures and spread wings near the top, lawn and trees around it.
zone-bird-sanctuary: Bill Jarvis Bird Sanctuary: a dense dark woodland grove wrapped by an organic fence loop; inside are a winding limestone path, layered wildflowers and an elevated wooden viewing deck. Reads like a secret garden room.
zone-waveland-fieldhouse: The Waveland fieldhouse with its landmark clock tower — pitched-roof brick fieldhouse, square tower with clock faces — just inside the golf course's SE corner by the trail.
zone-marovitz-golf-course: Sydney R. Marovitz golf course: fenced rolling fairways with greens, flags and bunkers stretching north; tee/green dressing, no buildings dominating.
sign-aids-garden: Wooden 'AIDS GARDEN' sign readable in frame, garden beds/lawn behind it.
sign-belmont-harbor: Wooden 'BELMONT HARBOR' sign readable, harbor water/docks context behind.
sign-dog-beach: Wooden 'DOG BEACH' sign readable, standing on GRASS north of the sand cove (not in the sand), facing the trail.
sign-bird-sanctuary: Wooden 'BIRD SANCTUARY' sign readable by the sanctuary's west gate, dense grove behind.
sign-waveland-fieldhouse: Wooden 'WAVELAND FIELDHOUSE' sign readable on the trail side; clock tower visible behind.
sign-yacht-club: Wooden 'YACHT CLUB' sign readable near the clubhouse lawn.
sign-waveland-tennis-courts: Wooden 'WAVELAND TENNIS COURTS' sign readable at the SE corner of the fenced 2x2 court block: green slabs, painted lines, sagging nets.
sign-diversey-range-mini-golf: Wooden 'DIVERSEY RANGE & MINI GOLF' sign readable SW of the range; two-tier driving-range bays and/or the tall perimeter net behind.
sign-future-entrance: Wooden 'FUTURE ENTRANCE →' gag sign beside the Belmont underpass mouth in the LSD berm; short tunnel/fenced door visible.
sign-future-entrance-2: Wooden 'FUTURE ENTRANCE →' gag sign at the Addison underpass in the LSD berm.
sign-future-entrance-3: Wooden 'FUTURE ENTRANCE →' gag sign at the Irving Park underpass in the LSD berm, far north.
deck-1: The corner pier: a plank deck jutting SOUTH over open water from the corner-wrap revetment, lamp at its tip; skyline backdrop to the south, water under the rails.
landmark-0: The harbor house: a small red-roofed harbor office building on the inner-park side of the basin.
wv-spawn: Arrival on the elevated Addison Red Line island platform (y 7.6): platform furniture/signage, twin tracks alongside, Wrigleyville streets below; down-the-platform framing, not clipped into walls.
wv-marquee: THE shot: the red Wrigley Field marquee on the ROUNDED Clark & Addison corner, reading like the real sign per the owner ref: arched crown with 'WRIGLEY FIELD' set along the arc, small 'HOME OF' over large 'CHICAGO CUBS', art-deco scroll shoulders, white pinstripe trim, and a black rounded message board with DOT-MATRIX lettering (live message line). The cream facade visibly curves behind it. A Chicagoan should recognize THIS sign instantly.
wv-scoreboard: The hand-turned green centerfield scoreboard high atop the bleachers (base ~18, top ~26.5): line-score grid, pennants above, no video boards (classic postcard Wrigley).
wv-gate-marquee: The Marquee Gate ON the rounded corner's apex under the marquee: gate recess in the curved cream facade with a walkable sidewalk apron in front, crowd/turnstile dressing.
wv-gate-gallagher: The Gallagher Way gate on the plaza's east side: brick facade arches opening onto the plaza.
wv-gate-bleacher: The Bleacher Gate at Sheffield & Waveland: brick corner entrance below the bleachers; Murphy's across the street.
wv-knothole: The knothole: a screened opening in the right-field wall on Sheffield where you can peek at the field inside.
wv-station-door: The station stair doorway on Addison under the girder rail bridge: solid green embankment mass, stair door, bridge overhead with the street passing beneath.
wv-murphys: Murphy's Bleachers bar at the SE corner of Sheffield & Waveland: low bar building with signage/neon, across from the bleacher wall.
wv-engine78: Engine 78 firehouse on Waveland: red-doored fire station beside the park (1052 W Waveland).
wv-cubby-bear: The Cubby Bear bar opposite the marquee corner: bar front with neon signage facing Clark & Addison.
wv-bar-sluggers: SLUGGERS bar front on the west side of Clark: neon signage + crossed bats readable. It is now a LOW 2-storey bar carrying the rooftop batting cage (task 009) — the exterior stair and cage read above the storefront; part of the glowing bar row.
wv-sluggers-cage: THE Sluggers rooftop batting cage (task 009): atop the lowered SLUGGERS bar, reachable by the exterior stair, a netted fast-pitch tunnel with the pitching machine and home plate sits on a rooftop deck the mayor can stand on. Reads as a real upstairs destination — not a street hut. The batter faces the park (east).
wv-sluggers-stair: The street approach to Sluggers on Clark: the low 2-storey bar with a visible exterior stair climbing its street face to the rooftop batting cage above, and a 'BATTING CAGES UPSTAIRS ↑' sign at the base. The cage is a destination you walk up to, not furniture on the sidewalk.
wv-bar-sports-corner: SPORTS CORNER bar front on the west side of Clark: neon signage readable in the bar row.
wv-bar-casey-s: CASEY'S bar front on the west side of Clark: neon signage readable in the bar row.
wv-bar-the-dugout: THE DUGOUT bar front on the west side of Clark: neon signage readable in the bar row.
wv-stall-0: A souvenir/cap stand on Addison by the station: caps, W flags, Cubs-blue merchandise on display.
wv-stall-1: A souvenir/cap stand mid-block on Addison, stadium facade context behind.
wv-stall-2: A souvenir/cap stand on Sheffield at Waveland near the bleacher corner.
wv-statue-row: Statue Row on Gallagher Way's north edge fronting the Gallagher office block: four bronze statues on limestone pedestals (Ernie Banks first), the office mass closing the plaza behind them.
wv-caray-statue: The Harry Caray statue on the west sidewalk outside the Bleacher Gate: exuberant pose with glasses; second Caray honor in the game, like Chicago does.
wv-gallagher-way: Gallagher Way plaza hugging the stadium's WEST stands along Clark: lawn/pavers, splash pad, planters, plaza life; the Gallagher office block closes its north end (the plaza no longer reaches Waveland).
wv-rooftop-view: From THE climbable Waveland rooftop (y 9.6): rooftop bleacher rows looking over Waveland INTO the park — outfield, scoreboard and light towers visible over the LF wall; EAMUS CATULI building nearby.
wv-barricade-addison-e: A CPD street closure: blue wooden A-frame barricades ('POLICE LINE') with an officer NPC closing Addison east past the station; Lakeview backdrop buildings continue beyond — diegetic wall, not a void.
wv-street-addison: Addison midblock street canyon: game-day street enclosed on BOTH sides — station embankment/stalls one way, stadium facade and storefronts the other. Every commercial ground floor shows a DOOR and glazing; lamp posts and street furniture (meters/hydrant/newsboxes) set a rhythm; no blank single-color wall longer than ~8 m; crosswalks and signals read at the corners.
wv-street-sheffield: Sheffield midblock canyon: bleacher wall + knothole on one side, rooftop-brownstone fronts (stoops, bay windows, doors) on the other. Furniture rhythm on the sidewalk; parked cars plausible; no bare prism walls.
wv-street-waveland: Waveland midblock canyon: brownstone fronts with stoops/doors/cornices facing the LF wall and Engine 78; rooftop bleachers visible above; street furniture rhythm; no blank walls.
wv-street-clark: Clark St diagonal canyon: continuous bar-row storefronts (doors, glazing, awnings, neon at storefront height) on the west side, Gallagher Way/stadium on the east; pennant strings overhead attach to real anchors; furniture + signal presence; the street feels SURROUNDED, not like boxes beside a plane.
